lines.text: Why are the finches on each island different?
lines.cn: 为什么每座岛上的雀鸟都不一样?

lines.text: Darwin suspected they had all evolved from one ancestor.
lines.cn: 达尔文猜想它们都是从一个原种进化来的。

lines.text: So their beaks changed to match the food?
lines.cn: 所以它们的喙因食物而改变了?

lines.text: Exactly. Each group had adapted to its own island.
lines.cn: 正是。每群鸟都适应了自己所在的岛。

lines.text: After the goats arrived, the tortoises had lost their food.
lines.cn: 山羊来了以后,陆龟就失去了食物。

lines.text: That's so sad. How can we protect such species?
lines.cn: 太可惜了。我们怎样才能保护这些物种?

lines.text: We can start by keeping their habitats clean and safe.
lines.cn: 我们可以从保持它们的栖息地干净、安全做起。

lines.text: Small actions really can change the world.
lines.cn: 小小的行动真的能改变世界。
